properties.description: This represents a complete collection of collared topographic maps, providing statewide coverage of Rhode Island. Original USGS Topographic Maps, in GeoPDF version, were compiled by the USGS in the spring to summer of 2015. The US Topo replaces the 7.5-minute quadrangles of old, but these GIS-derived maps are based on this familiar format. These images were converted from GeoPDF into GeoTIFF format for use in GIS software by the University of Rhode Island Environmental Data Center.

properties.snippet: This data set contains center lines for all bicycle paths, bicycle routes, and bicycle lane center lines for all statewide and local bikeways, bike routes, and bike lanes for the entire state of Rhode Island.
properties.description:
This hosted feature layer has been published in RI State Plane Feet NAD 83 

This data set was created for the Rhode Island Department of Transportation. This data set contains COMPLETED, UNDER CONSTRUCTION IN 2015, UNDER DESIGN, STUDY AND DEVELOPMENT, and DROPPED BICYCLE PATHS, ROUTES, and BIKE LANE CENTER LINES for all statewide and local bikeways, bike routes, and bike lanes for the state of Rhode Island. The linear center lines were digitized from 2011 Orthophotos 4' pixel resolution at 5000' scale.

properties.snippet: This is a polygon layer that shows historic wildfires in Rhode Island from 1920-1970, attributed to the 10-year period the fire took place in.
properties.description:
This hosted feature layer has been published in RI State Plane Feet NAD 83.

This polygon layer shows historic wildfires in Rhode Island from 1920-1970, attributed to the 10-year period they took place in. The layer was created by digitizing features from a georeferenced scanned map from the Rhode Island Department of Environmental Managment Division of Forestry, of wildfires that occurred in Rhode Island between 1920 and 1970. This layer was created by Caleb Maytum with help from Dr. Jason Parent in the University of Rhode Island Environmental Data Center.

properties.snippet: This data set was created for the Rhode Island Department of Transportation to show and reference all rail lines, active and inactive, as well as abandoned trolley lines in the state of Rhode Island.
properties.description:
This hosted feature layer has been published in RI State Plane Feet NAD 83

This dataset represents railroad rights of way (including rail lines, active and inactive, as well as abandoned trolley lines) present within Rhode Island.

This data set was created for the Rhode Island Department of Transportation to show and reference all rail lines, active and inactive, as well as abandoned trolley lines in the state of Rhode Island.

Rail coverage contains all rail center lines, active and inactive, as well as abandoned trolley lines and old abandoned rail systems now used for other than rail purposes digitized from Spring 1997 photography and since updated using aerial photography from Spring 2008. National Grid (New England Electric System) contracted with Intermap Technologies, Ontario, Canada in creating the original Massachusetts, Rhode Island 1:5000 scale dataset using digital orthophotography.

properties.snippet: Evacuation areas based upon worst case hurricane surge scenarios for category 1 through 4 hurricanes striking the coast of Rhode Island
properties.description:
This hosted feature layer has been published in RI State Plane Feet NAD 83.

Evacuation areas based upon worst case hurricane surge scenarios for category 1 through 4 hurricanes striking the coast of Rhode Island. Hurricane surge values were developed by the National Hurricane Center using the SLOSH (Sea Lake and Overland Surge from Hurricanes) Model. This Surge Inundation layer was created by the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, New England District. Using ArcInfo's Grid extension, bare earth elevation data from several sources was subtracted from the worst-case hurricane surge values to determine which areas could be expected to be inundated.

This layer was developed to assist emergency management officials in hurricane preparedness and operations. This statewide dataset compiled from county-based datasets originally developed and published by the US Army Corps of Engineers.
